result.reason: The addition includes the required professional-and-workmanlike standard, 12-month Site conformance warranty, legal compliance, malicious-code protection, and repair/re-performance/replacement/refund remedies. However, it omits the required 90-day warranty period for Services, and the Site warranty runs from the Effective Date rather than delivery or acceptance, which could materially shorten its practical duration. The targeted addition otherwise preserves the original provisions and is reasonably concise, though “this warranty” is imprecise because subsection (c) contains several warranties.
